name: Gold mine

real.basis: Boddington produced 590,000 oz of gold in 2024, 18350 kg at 31.103 g a troy ounce (Newmont operating statistics, Q4 2024); its 1,000 employees and about 700 contractors (technical report summary, 2022) are the 1,700 workers; 3,304,583 GJ of grid electricity in 2024 is 104.7 MW on average, and 29,710 ML of water withdrawn in 2024 is 3,389 t an hour (Newmont 2024 performance data); the mine also makes copper, which these figures include

bpBasis: Newmont narrowed the capital cost of the Boddington expansion project to $2.8 to $2.9 billion on a 100% basis at its start-up in 2009, capitalised interest excluded; the top of the range

real.plant: Mogalakwena platinum mine, Limpopo, South Africa (Valterra Platinum)
real.basis: Mogalakwena produced 947,800 oz of platinum-group metals in concentrate in 2025, 29480 kg at 31.103 g a troy ounce, the basis of Earth's platinum reserve (Valterra Platinum integrated report 2025); about 2,486 employees and 7,405 contractors at the time of the IRMA audit (2025) are the 9,891 workers; the report gives energy only with diesel included, so power and water are open, and no figure for iridium is published

real.plant: Greens Creek silver mine, Admiralty Island, Alaska (Hecla Mining)
real.basis: Greens Creek produced 9.2 Moz of silver in 2021, 286200 kg at 31.103 g a troy ounce, with 457 employees (technical report summary, 2022); the life of mine plan buys 769 million kWh and generates 132 million kWh over the 14 years to 2035, 64.36 GWh a year or 7.34 MW; its intake draws up to 700 US gallons a minute of fresh water from Greens Creek, 159 t an hour, the intake's capacity rather than metered use; it also makes zinc, lead and gold

real.plant: Spor Mountain bertrandite mine and Delta mill, Utah (Materion)
real.basis: The only US beryllium mine shipped about 180 t of beryllium content in 2024 (USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2025), Materion's Spor Mountain mine and its Delta mill, which employ just over 100 operating personnel (technical report summary, 2021); power and water are not published

real.plant: Gallium line at the Aluminium of Greece alumina refinery, Agios Nikolaos (METLEN)
real.basis: METLEN is building a gallium line of 50 t a year at its alumina refinery (METLEN, 2025); its staff, power, water and cost are published only with the alumina expansion

real.plant: Indium refinery at the Auby zinc smelter, France (Nyrstar)
real.basis: Auby's indium refinery can make 72 t of indium a year (Nyrstar fact sheet, 2016); its staff, power and water are published only for the whole zinc smelter

real.plant: Germanium plant at the Onsan zinc smelter, Ulsan, South Korea (Korea Zinc)
real.basis: Korea Zinc's new germanium plant at Onsan is to make high-purity germanium dioxide equal to about 10 t of germanium a year (Evertiq, 2025); its staff, power and water are not published

real.plant: Arsenic trioxide plant of the Tsumeb copper smelter, Namibia (Dundee Precious Metals Tsumeb, now Sinomine)
real.basis: Tsumeb produces about 4,200 t of arsenic trioxide a year (New Era, 2024), 3181 t of arsenic at 75.7% arsenic in As2O3; its staff, power and water are published only for the whole smelter

real.plant: Molyb molybdenite roasting and rhenium recovery plant, Mejillones, Chile (Codelco)
real.basis: Molyb is to process 16,500 t of molybdenum and 8 t of rhenium a year (MundoMarítimo, 2016); its staff, power and water are not published

real.plant: Mountain Pass rare earth mine and plant, California (MP Materials)
real.basis: Mountain Pass produced 45,455 t of rare earth oxides in concentrate in 2024 with 804 full-time equivalent employees, its Texas magnet plant included (MP Materials 10-K for 2024); its gas-fired combined heat and power plant of up to 26 MW supplies substantially all its power (technical report summary, 2024), the rating standing for its demand; it withdrew 716,150 m3 of fresh water in 2024, 81.7 t an hour (sustainability report 2025); no share of neodymium, samarium, yttrium or thorium is published, so its rates are open

name: Graphite mine

real.plant: Balama graphite mine and concentrator, Cabo Delgado, Mozambique (Syrah Resources)
real.basis: Balama's plant can make about 350 kt of graphite concentrate a year from 2 Mt of ore (Syrah Resources), with more than 1,250 direct and contractor employees (Syrah annual report 2023); its 15.4 MW diesel power station stands for its demand; its water is not published

bpBasis: The Balama feasibility study put its initial capital cost at $138 million with 10% contingency (2015)

real.plant: AGS Vein fluorspar mine and mill, St. Lawrence, Newfoundland (Canada Fluorspar)
real.basis: St. Lawrence's mill was registered for up to 200,000 t of fluorspar concentrate a year, with 164 full-time positions and 218 m3 an hour of process water plus 2 m3 an hour of fresh water (environmental assessment registration, 2015), the design figures; its power is not published

real.plant: Mangampet barytes mine, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh (APMDC)
real.basis: Mangampet produced 664,800 t of A-grade and 63,227 t of B-grade barytes in 2013-14 (CAG performance audit, 2017), 428400 t of barium at the 58.8% barium of pure BaSO4, since no grade is published; its staff, power and water are not published for the mine

real.plant: Elkem Tana quartzite quarry, Finnmark, Norway (Elkem)
real.basis: Tana has a capacity of 1,000,000 t of quartzite a year with 50 employees, 25 of them contractors (Elkem), 467.4 kt of silicon at the 46.7% silicon of pure SiO2, since no grade is published; its power and water are not published

real.plant: North Antelope Rochelle coal mine, Powder River Basin, Wyoming (Peabody)
real.basis: North Antelope Rochelle produced 62.8 million short tons of coal in 2021, 20.64 Mt of carbon at its 50.6% dry fixed carbon and 28.4% moisture as received, fixed carbon standing for carbon; it has 1,085 employees and typically uses about 260,000,000 kWh of electricity, 29.7 MW on average, and 450,000,000 US gallons of water a year, 194.3 t an hour (technical report summary, 2022)
